Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Due to changes made by SI 2023/271 - Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) (Amendment) Regulations 2023 - this offence no longer applies from the 29th June 2023. For the offences applying after this date, see H101363 (failure to give assistance) and H101364 (obstruct / delay).
